purpose: Single machine-readable home for CYNIC agent policy: authority chain and fact-dictated decision routing. Prose in AGENTS.md and docs/specs/agent-constitution.md are leads; this contract seals.

policy_chain.role: Entry every agent reads. Pointers only, never copies.
Machine-readable role capabilities, enforced by Rust where loaded.

single_home_rule: One statement, one home. AGENTS.md and constitution prose point here; they never restate a rule sealed below.

facts_dictate_routing.principle: Never pose the operator a dilemma that observed data can resolve.

routes.action: Act within authority, then report the fact-to-action chain. No question, no options.
Observe more, narrow the unknowns, then act. Still no question.
Ask the operator a single question with the unknowns stated. This is the only permitted question path.

facts_dictate_routing.rationale: Every dilemma pushed upward that measurement could have resolved spends operator attention without proof: a silent cost amplification. Operator sovereignty is reserved for sovereign choices, never for arbitrating what data already decided.

transposition_target.tests: dictated -> act; closable_gap -> observe; beyond_authority -> one_explicit_question

amendment.rule: Prose change first, then this contract version bumps (minor for routes, major for chain), then Rust types, then tests, then make check green.
